paragraphs: Frost Solutions sells road weather monitoring hardware and software for the crews who fight snow and ice. The stated audience is municipalities and contractors.

The core device is a solar-powered unit that mounts easily and captures hyperlocal weather data every minute. It tracks road surface temperature, grip and coefficient of friction forecasts, air conditions and visibility. Site-level readings also cover pavement temperature, humidity, dew point and frost. The software reviews site photos and weather data every minute and raises an alert when conditions change. Its dashboard carries snow and frost alerts, surface temperature updates and hyperlocal 72-hour forecasts.

Contractors are told to put units in customer parking lots to decide where to send crews first. School districts are another named market, where campuses and multiple buildings are hard to cover. The site says it serves communities in 37 states and 7 provinces.

quote.text: Frost Solutions gives you the tools to monitor conditions and mobilize faster, all from the palm of your hand.
